scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true });"
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
